Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000808": As of 2025-10-27, Tomasz Nowak is back on the Team Dune on-call rotation, carrying the pager for this cycle.  (about: Tomasz Nowak, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000802": As of 2025-10-27, Tomasz Nowak is the primary on-call for Team Dune for this cycle, instead of Farah.  (about: Tomasz Nowak, Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000782" [decision]: On 2025-10-22, Team Dune agreed that the webhooks service will sign payloads with rotating keys because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review.  (about: Team Dune, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000757": As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune; Team Atlas kept it until then.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000753": As of 2025-10-15, the pager for the scheduler rings Team Dune instead of Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000709" [decision]: On 2025-09-15, Team Dune decided that the reporting service will read from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger, Team Dune, event bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000596": On the 2025-07-30 rotation day, Farah handed the Team Dune pager to Tomasz Nowak.  (about: Tomasz Nowak, Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000580" [decision]: On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder's standup decided that clients will cache feature-flags service evaluations for 30 seconds.  (about: Team Cinder, feature-flags service, clients)
- memory_id "1000470" [decision]: As of 2025-06-13, the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node, because the fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.  (about: scheduler)
- memory_id "1000464": On 2025-06-12, Team Dune noticed that the notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000420" [decision]: Team Dune has switched to a monthly game day.  (about: Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000402" [constraint]: The billing service ships only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.  (about: billing service)
- memory_id "1000387": Dashboards and alerts for the resizer are being repointed as of 2025-04-29.  (about: resizer)
- memory_id "1000286": The scheduler pulls per-job kill switches from the feature-flags service on every run.  (about: feature-flags service, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000268": As of 2025-03-24, Farah still has the Team Dune pager.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000255": As of 2025-03-20, the pager for the catalog service rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000244" [constraint]: The scheduler deploys on weekdays after 15:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: scheduler)
- memory_id "1000241" [constraint]: The webhooks service ships only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000186" [constraint]: The reporting service may be released only on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC, and any other release time requires an exception.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000098": Farah takes the first on-call rotation for Team Dune.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
